BenchGSEAConfig: GSEA Benchmark Configuration

Source: R/04i-BenchGSEAConfig.R
BenchGSEAConfig.Rd

BenchGSEAConfig stores the configuration of a GSEA benchmark run performed by BenchGSEA(). It extends BenchConfig with the GSEA-specific controls collected in bench_config; the inputs shared by every screening method (matched_bulk, sc_data, phenotype, label_type, phenotype_class, screen_method) and the method specific arguments collected in method_param are inherited from BenchConfig.

Usage

BenchGSEAConfig(
  matched_bulk,
  sc_data,
  phenotype,
  label_type = "{method_name}",
  phenotype_class = c("binary", "survival", "continuous"),
  screen_method = names(ScreenStrategy),
  method_param = MethodParamSet(),
  bench_config = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

matched_bulk

matrix or data.frame. Bulk expression data (genes x samples) matching phenotype. Shared by all methods.

sc_data

A Seurat object to be screened.

phenotype

Phenotype data, either a named vector or a patient survival data frame. See Screen().

label_type

character or NULL. Length-one glue-style template for the phenotype label type, with {method_name} available. When NULL or not of length one, it falls back to "{method_name}" with an informational message.

phenotype_class

character. One or more of "binary", "continuous", "survival". Default: all three.

screen_method

character. One or more method names registered in ScreenStrategy, giving the methods to benchmark and their order. Default: "Scissor".

method_param

Named list of method-specific arguments, each passed only to the executor of the method it is named after (e.g. list(Scissor_param = list(alpha = 0.05))). Default: MethodParamSet(), i.e. one empty entry per registered method.

bench_config

Named list of GSEA controls returned by BenchGSEAConfigSet(). It holds pathway (a named list of gene sets), optionally group (one group label per cell in sc_data), plus optional arguments forwarded to fgsea::fgsea() such as minSize, maxSize and gseaParam. group, when supplied, must have the same length as the number of cells in sc_data. Default: list(), which is rejected by the validator because pathway is required.

...

Must be empty. Method specific arguments belong in method_param.

Value

A BenchGSEAConfig S7 object.

See also

Other S7-Classes: AnnotationMethod(), BenchAccConfig(), BenchConfig(), BenchGeneScoreConfig(), BenchMemoryConfig(), ScreenMethodCache(), ScreenMethodConfig(), ScreenMethodResult()
